## Figures

```{r dataone}

dialect_monthly <- raw_long_clean %>% 
  mutate(dateUploaded = as.Date(dateUploaded)) %>% 
  filter(dateUploaded > as.Date("2005-01-01")) %>% 
  mutate(month_ym = floor_date(dateUploaded, "month")) %>%
  distinct(pid, month_ym, dialect) %>% 
  count(month_ym, dialect) %>%
  complete(month_ym, dialect, fill = list(n = 0)) %>%
  group_by(dialect) %>%
  arrange(month_ym) %>%
  mutate(cum_n = cumsum(n)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(month_ym) %>%
  mutate(total_cum_n = sum(cum_n), cum_prop = cum_n / total_cum_n) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(cum_prop = replace_na(cum_prop, 0))

total_monthly <- dialect_monthly %>%
  distinct(month_ym, total_cum_n)


p2 <- ggplot(dialect_monthly, aes(x = month_ym, y = cum_prop, fill = dialect)) +
```

### 1. Repository Effects

```{r mean-score-dist-plot}
node_scores <- agg_scores %>% 
  filter(is.na(obsoletedBy)) %>% 
  get_node_scores_all_time()

ridge_data <- node_scores %>%
  mutate(score_100 = score * 100,
    label = factor(label, levels = rev(c("Findable", "Accessible", "Interoperable", "Reusable"))))

ggplot(ridge_data, aes(x = score, y = label, fill = label)) +
  geom_density_ridges(scale = 1.5, alpha = 0.85, color = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Findable"      = "#785EF0", 
      "Accessible"    = "#DC267F", 
      "Interoperable" = "#FE6100",

  ) +

    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),

    title = ""
  )

ggsave("mean-score-dist.png", height = 5, width = 6, units = "in")
```

Figure 1: Distribution of mean metadata completeness across 40 DataONE member repositories. Repository averages are calculated from individual dataset scores.

```{r inline-helper}
get_metric <- function(data, metric, fn) {
  if (fn == "mean") {
    metric <- round(filter(data, label == metric) %>% pull(score_100) %>% mean(na.rm = TRUE), 2)
  } else if (fn == "sd") {
    metric <- round(filter(data, label == metric) %>% pull(score_100) %>% sd(na.rm = TRUE), 2)
  } else if (fn == "q_10") {
    metric <- round(filter(data, label == metric) %>% pull(score_100) %>% quantile(probs = 0.10, na.rm = TRUE), 2)
  } else if (fn == "q_90") {
    metric <- round(filter(data, label == metric) %>% pull(score_100) %>% quantile(probs = 0.90, na.rm = TRUE), 2)
  } else if (fn == "median") {
    metric <- round(filter(data, label == metric) %>% pull(score_100) %>% median(na.rm = TRUE), 2)
  } 
  return(metric)
}
```


Repository-level metadata quality varied across the `r length(nodes_to_analyse)` repositories included in the analysis (Figure 2). Among the four FAIR principles, repositories scored the highest in the Findable metric (M = `r get_metric(node_scores, "Findable", "mean")`, SD = `r get_metric(node_scores, "Findable", "sd")`), followed by Accessible (M = `r get_metric(node_scores, "Accessible", "mean")`, SD = `r get_metric(node_scores, "Accessible", "sd")`), Interoperable (M = `r get_metric(node_scores, "Interoperable", "mean")`, SD = `r get_metric(node_scores, "Interoperable", "sd")`), and Reusable (M = `r get_metric(node_scores, "Reusable", "mean")`, SD = `r get_metric(node_scores, "Reusable", "sd")`). The variability also differed among FAIR metrics. Interoperable scores exhibited the greatest variability across repositories, with a `r get_metric(node_scores, "Interoperable", 'q_90') - get_metric(node_scores, "Interoperable", 'q_10')`% difference between the 90th and 10th percentiles. In contrast, Findable scores were comparatively consistent, differing by `r get_metric(node_scores, "Findable", 'q_90') - get_metric(node_scores, "Findable", 'q_10')`%. across the same percentile range. Accessible and Reusable scores displayed intermediate variability.


### Fig 2: Dialect Effects

```{r calc-max-score}
fair_checks <- open_dataset("/home/jclark/metadig-data/check-data-0.5.0") %>% 
  select(check_id, check_name, check_type, check_level) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  collect() %>% 
  cross_join(tibble(dialect = c("EML", "ISO", "SOSO")))

check_supported <- read.csv("/home/jclark/metadig-dataone-fair/inst/data/check-error-fail-reasons-summary.csv") %>% 
  select(check_name, dialect, notes_controlled) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  full_join(fair_checks, by = c("check_name", "dialect")) %>%
  mutate(is_supported = case_when(notes_controlled == "not supported" ~ FALSE,
                                  notes_controlled != "not supported" ~ TRUE,
                                  is.na(notes_controlled) ~ TRUE)) 


dialect_scores <- check_supported %>%
  mutate(
    status = ifelse(is_supported, "pass", "fail"),
    is_required = tolower(check_level) %in% c("required", "r"),
    is_optional = tolower(check_level) %in% c("optional", "o")
  ) %>%
  group_by(dialect, check_type) %>%
  summarize(
    Pr = sum(status == "pass" & is_required, na.rm = TRUE),
    Po = sum(status == "pass" & is_optional, na.rm = TRUE),
    Fr = sum(status == "fail" & is_required, na.rm = TRUE),
    Fo = sum(status == "fail" & is_optional, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # (Pr + Po) / (Pr + Po + Fr)
    max_score = (Pr + Po) / (Pr + Po + Fr)
  ) %>% 
  mutate(check_type = factor(check_type, levels = c("Findable", "Accessible", "Interoperable", "Reusable")))
```

```{r dialect-plots}
ggplot(raw_long_clean, aes(x = score, y = dialect, fill = dialect)) +

    data = dialect_scores,
    aes(xmin = max_score, xmax = max_score, y = dialect),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    color = "#974665",
    width = 0.9,
    linewidth = 0.75,
    alpha = 0.75
  ) +
  geom_density_ridges(
    alpha = 0.9, 
    scale = 2,         
    color = "black",     
    linewidth = 0.1,

  ) +
  facet_grid(~ check_type) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(), limits = c(0, 1.05)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("SOSO" = "#F2A900", "ISO"  = "#634a36", "EML"  = "#2B90E8")) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none", 
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray95"),
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Score", 
    y = "Metadata Dialect",
    #caption = "Density distributions of dataset completeness scores."
  ) +
  coord_flip()

ggsave("dialect-effects.png", width = 7, height = 6, units = "in")
```

Figure 2: Distribution of dataset-level score frequencies across metadata dialects and FAIR dimensions. Solid red lines show the maximum possible score for each dialect/dimension.

### Fig 3: Time Effects

```{r}
monthly_avg <- agg_scores %>% 
  group_by(datasource) %>% 
  group_modify(~ get_scores_quantiles_ym(.)) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(metric = factor(
    metric, 
    levels = c("scoreFindable", "scoreAccessible", "scoreInteroperable", "scoreReusable"),
    labels = c("Findable", "Accessible", "Interoperable", "Reusable")))

monthly_avg_smoothed <- monthly_avg %>%
  filter(ym > as.Date("2005-01-01")) %>% 
  arrange(datasource, metric, ym) %>%
  group_by(datasource, metric) %>%
  filter(n() > 6) %>%
  mutate(
    # 3 month rolling window
    mean_score = rollmean(mean_score, k = 3, fill = "extend"),
    p25        = rollmean(p25, k = 3, fill = "extend"),
    p75        = rollmean(p75, k = 3, fill = "extend")
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

global_mean_smoothed <- monthly_avg %>%
  filter(ym > as.Date("2005-01-01")) %>% 
  group_by(metric, ym) %>%
  summarise(global_avg = mean(mean_score, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(metric, ym) %>%
  group_by(metric) %>%
  mutate(smooth_mean = rollmean(global_avg, k = 3, fill = "extend")) %>%
  ungroup()


p1 <- ggplot() +
  geom_line(
    data = monthly_avg_smoothed,
    aes(x = ym, y = mean_score/100, color = datasource, group = datasource),
    alpha = 0.25,
    linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_line(
    data = global_mean_smoothed,
    aes(x = ym, y = smooth_mean/100),
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 1.3) +
  facet_wrap(~ metric, ncol = 1) +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "mako") + 
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format()) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray95"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_blank()) +
  labs(y = "Score") +
  xlim(as.Date("2005-01-01"), as.Date("2026-01-01"))

p1
ggsave("monthly-timeseries-anon.png", width = 5, height = 8, units = "in")
```

Figure 3: Panel A: Timeseries of mean monthly scores with a 3 month running mean across the four FAIR dimensions. Solid black line is the overall DataONE mean. Lighter lines are individual repository timeseries. Panel B: Cumulative number of datasets across DataONE. Panel C: Cumulative share of datasets by dialect across DataONE. 



### Fig 4: Curation Effects

```{r curation-plot}
arctic <- agg_scores %>% 
  filter(datasource == "urn:node:ARCTIC")
data_seq <- assign_sequence_id(arctic) 
data_ver <- get_first_last_versions(data_seq)
data_ver <- data_ver %>% 
  filter(version_position != "only_version")

arctic_mean <- data_ver %>% 
  group_by(version_position) %>% 
  group_modify(~ get_scores_cum_mean_ym(.x)) %>% 
  ungroup()

ggplot(data = arctic_mean, aes(x = ym, y = mean/100)) +
  geom_line(
    aes(linetype = version_position, color = metric), 
    linewidth = 0.8,
    alpha = 0.9) +
  facet_wrap(~metric, ncol = 2, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("first" = "twodash", "last" = "solid")) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Findable"      = "#785EF0", 
      "Accessible"    = "#DC267F", 
      "Interoperable" = "#FE6100", 
      "Reusable"      = "#FFB000"
    )
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format()) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "mako", begin = 0.3, end = 0.7) + 
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box = "horizontal",
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray95"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  ) +
  guides(color = "none", fill = "none") +
  labs(
    title = "",
    linetype = "Version",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Score"
  )

ggsave("curation-effects.png", width = 6, height = 5, units = "in")
```
Figure 4: Timeseries of cumulative mean dataset scores across the four FAIR dimensions for the Arctic Data Center repository. Dashed lines show the scores of only first submitted versions of a dataset, solid lines show the scores of only final versions of the same datasets.

## Figure 5: Repository Policy Effects

```{r}
node_list <- c("urn:node:EDI", "urn:node:LTER", "urn:node:ARCTIC")

node_states <- agg_scores %>%
  filter(datasource %in% node_list) %>%
  mutate(dateUploaded = as.Date(dateUploaded)) %>%
  group_by(datasource) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    .x %>%
      assign_sequence_id() %>%
      get_scores_monthly_state()
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(datasource = case_when(
      datasource == "urn:node:EDI" ~ "Environmental Data Initiative",
      datasource == "urn:node:LTER" ~ "Long Term Ecological Research",
      datasource == "urn:node:ARCTIC" ~ "Arctic Data Center")) %>% 
  mutate(metric = factor(metric, levels = rev(c("f", "a", "i", "r"))))

vline_data <- data.frame(
  datasource = c("Environmental Data Initiative", "Long Term Ecological Research", "Arctic Data Center"),
  target_date = as.Date(c("2021-10-01", "2015-01-01", "2017-05-30"))
)

ggplot(node_states, aes(x = ym, y = mean/100, color = metric)) +
  geom_vline(
    data = vline_data, 
    aes(xintercept = target_date), 
    linetype = "dashed", 
    color = "black", 
    linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(
    breaks = c("f", "a", "i", "r"),
    values = c(
      "f" = "#785EF0", 
      "a" = "#DC267F", 
      "i" = "#FE6100", 
      "r" = "#FFB000"),
    labels = c(
      "f" = "Findable",
      "a" = "Accessible",
      "i" = "Interoperable",
      "r" = "Reusable")) +
  facet_wrap(~datasource, nrow = 1) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format()) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box = "horizontal",
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray95"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,                       
    y = "Score",
    color = NULL,
    title = NULL)

ggsave("policy-effects.png", width = 10, height = 4, units = "in")
```

```{r}
  collect() %>%
```
